Container.Name: Slop Meal Planner
Container.Overview: Production Slop Meal Planner application. This image runs the web server, Celery worker, and scheduler together. Install PostgreSQL and Redis separately first; the Repository value is the public Docker image, not the GitHub source URL.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 15-18, Redis 7.2/7.4, and an HTTPS reverse proxy or authenticated private overlay. Use one Slop container because Celery Beat must run once.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Choose the LAN host port. Keep the container target at 8000.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent application files. The container target must remain /data.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Verified database and application-data archives. The container target must remain /backups.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: Unraid server LAN IP, hostname, or PostgreSQL container name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL port
Config.Description: Reachable PostgreSQL TCP port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL database
Config.Description: Application database name; letters, numbers, and underscores only.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL user
Config.Description: Application database role; letters, numbers, and underscores only.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Password for the PostgreSQL role.

Config.Name: Redis host
Config.Description: Reachable standalone Redis host, IP, or container name.

Config.Name: Redis port
Config.Description: Reachable standalone Redis TCP port.

Config.Name: Redis password
Config.Description: Strong Redis password, required when Redis is published on the LAN.

Config.Name: Application secret key
Config.Description: Independent random value of at least 32 characters. Preserve it permanently because rotating it makes encrypted integration credentials unreadable.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Independent random value of at least 32 characters used to create the first owner.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated actual LAN IPs, hostnames, and reverse-proxy names used to open Slop.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Required for the supported HTTPS deployment. Do not expose passwords or sessions over direct LAN HTTP.

Config.Name: HSTS
Config.Description: Send Strict-Transport-Security in the supported HTTPS deployment.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone. The application timezone is derived from this value.

Config.Name: Runtime user ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID.

Config.Name: Runtime group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL SSL mode
Config.Description: Advanced libpq SSL mode.

Config.Name: Redis ACL username
Config.Description: Optional Redis ACL username.

Config.Name: Redis TLS
Config.Description: Use rediss:// when Redis TLS is enabled.

Config.Name: Redis broker database
Config.Description: Redis logical database for Celery tasks.

Config.Name: Redis result database
Config.Description: Redis logical database for Celery results; must differ from the broker database.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL override
Config.Description: Advanced full PostgreSQL URL override. When set, it wins over friendly PostgreSQL fields.

Config.Name: Celery broker URL override
Config.Description: Advanced full Redis broker URL override. When set, it wins over friendly Redis fields.

Config.Name: Celery result URL override
Config.Description: Advanced full Redis result URL override. When set, it wins over friendly Redis fields.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Application and worker log level.

Config.Name: Daily backup retention
Config.Description: Daily backup folders to retain.

Config.Name: Weekly backup retention
Config.Description: Weekly backup folders to retain.

Config.Name: Monthly backup retention
Config.Description: Monthly backup folders to retain.

Config.Name: USDA FoodData Central API key
Config.Description: Optional private key for general-food search.

Config.Name: Remote food search
Config.Description: Enable remote food search providers.

Config.Name: Open Food Facts
Config.Description: Enable read-only packaged-food lookups.

Config.Name: Open Food Facts timeout
Config.Description: Remote Open Food Facts request timeout in seconds.
